comments.text:
I agree with Todd when it comes to character leveling. Games that are strict in the sense of... you can make wrong choices while leveling up your character and it really leaves you in a rut with no way to change it, I hate it. It's such an awful experience to me. That's not "hardcare", because there is no way to know your choices are wrong until you make those wrong choices or look it up online, and that's just not fun to me. Trial and error in a game where an error can cost you hours of your time... I just stop playing it.

I also have never been a fan of classes, which is why I liked BGS' approach where you can learn pretty much anything you want. But I didn't mind the way it was done in Oblivion because even when you choose a class it's not like you can't learn everything else.
